name: Hilde
source:
A dark elf dancer who boasts of her popularity with the public.
She is a friendly lady with a lot of sex appeal.
She is cheerful and kind to everyone and cannot overlook anyone who is in trouble.

Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1243618
